FFE-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Facial Expression Editing
  



       
       
       
       
  





	
		
		📘 Dataset Overview
	

FFE-Bench is a benchmark for fine-grained facial expression editing across both human and anime portraits, with richer and more diverse expression categories designed to evaluate controllable facial editing in realistic settings.
The current release contains 198 editing tasks in total, including 98 human samples and 100 anime samples. Each… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PixelSmile/FFE-Bench.
evaluation_method: human_eval / LPIPS / FID / identity and attribute consistency metrics
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for controllable facial expression editing (human and anime), referenced by researchers working on fine-grained facial editing.
